group.passage: Do you listen to music through earphones on your way to school? Many young people do. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), more than 1 billion young adults are at risk of losing some of their hearing for good because of unsafe listening habits. In other words, the hearing they lose will never come back. The good news is that this kind of hearing loss can be prevented. Sound is measured in decibels (dB). A quiet library is about 40 dB, and a normal conversation is about 60 dB. Sounds at this level are safe, no matter how long you hear them. The danger begins when sounds get louder and last longer. The WHO says sounds below 80 dB are unlikely to harm your hearing, but above that level, the safe time drops quickly. As the table below shows, you can safely hear an 80 dB sound for 40 hours a week. At 90 dB, the safe time falls to just 4 hours, and at 100 dB, about as loud as a hair dryer, it is only 20 minutes. Even a single very loud sound can hurt the tiny cells inside your ears. How can you tell if a place is too noisy? Here is a simple test: if you have to raise your voice to be heard by someone an arm's length away, the sound is too loud. There are easy ways to protect your ears. Keep the volume of your phone at no more than 60 percent of the highest level. Headphones that block outside noise can also help, because you will not need to turn the music up. At concerts and other loud events, wear earplugs, and give your ears a rest in a quiet place for 10 minutes every hour. Finally, if you often hear a ringing sound in your ears, it is a good idea to have your hearing checked.

translation_zh.text:
你上學途中會用耳機聽音樂嗎？很多年輕人都會。根據世界衛生組織（WHO），超過 10 億名年輕人因為不安全的聆聽習慣，面臨永久失去部分聽力的風險。換句話說，他們失去的聽力將永遠不會回來。好消息是，這種聽力損失是可以預防的。
聲音是用分貝（dB）來測量的。安靜的圖書館大約是 40 分貝，一般交談大約是 60 分貝。這種程度的聲音是安全的，不論聽多久都沒關係。當聲音變得更大、持續更久時，危險就開始了。世界衛生組織說，低於 80 分貝的聲音不太可能傷害聽力，但超過這個程度，安全的時間就會迅速縮短。如下表所示，80 分貝的聲音每週可以安全地聽 40 個小時。到了 90 分貝，安全時間降到只有 4 小時；而在 100 分貝，大約和吹風機一樣大聲時，就只有 20 分鐘。即使只是一次非常大的聲音，也可能傷害你耳朵裡微小的細胞。
怎麼知道一個地方是不是太吵？這裡有一個簡單的測試：如果你必須提高音量，才能讓一臂之遙的人聽見你說話，那聲音就太大了。
保護耳朵有一些簡單的方法。把手機的音量維持在最大音量的 60% 以下。能阻隔外界噪音的耳機也有幫助，因為你就不需要把音樂調大聲。在演唱會和其他吵雜的活動中，要戴耳塞，而且每小時到安靜的地方讓耳朵休息 10 分鐘。最後，如果你經常聽到耳朵裡有鳴響聲，最好去檢查聽力。
